name: wiz-marketplace
description: Context-efficient Claude Code plugins from Scott's AI Wizard (Wiz) collection.

plugins.name: browser-agent
plugins.description: Browser automation with persistent Chrome sessions. Full Playwright API access without the context bloat.

plugins.name: fal-agent
plugins.description: AI media generation using fal.ai. Smart model selection for images, videos, and audio without the research.

plugins.name: book-creator
plugins.description: Create structured books and documents with chapters, formatting, and export options.

plugins.name: app-feedback-now
plugins.description: Leave inline comments on a live web app without touching the source. Bookmarklet + localhost sidecar; Claude edits source files in response. Fork of make-pages-interactive adapted for wrangler/vite/astro dev servers.

plugins.name: work
plugins.description: Persistent FIFO work queue for isolated, sequential task execution. Add tasks, drain them one at a time with isolated worker agents, or auto-process with a /work:monitor watcher.
